name: Employment Offer Letter
description: An employer offers a position to a candidate and sets out the key terms of employment.

sections.title: Offer
Start Date and Location
sections.text: Your employment will begin on {{start_date}}. Your primary place of work will be {{work_location}}.

sections.title: Compensation
sections.text: Your annual base salary will be {{salary_amount}} {{currency}}, payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll schedule and subject to applicable deductions and withholdings.

sections.title: Benefits
sections.text: You will be eligible to participate in the benefit programs the Company makes available to employees in your position, subject to the terms of those programs, which the Company may amend from time to time.

sections.title: Probation
sections.text: Your first {{probation_months}} month(s) of employment will be a probationary period during which your performance and suitability for the role will be assessed.

sections.title: Notice of Termination
sections.text: Either you or the Company may end your employment by giving {{notice_period_days}} days' written notice, subject to applicable employment law.

sections.title: Conditions
sections.text: This offer is conditional on your right to work in the country of employment and on satisfactory completion of any background checks disclosed to you. You will be asked to sign the Company's standard confidentiality and intellectual property assignment agreement.

sections.title: Acceptance
